The [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] '''DH-23 "Outback" blaster pistol''' was a highly durable [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and was a variant of the venerable [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]].<ref name="AAEG" />

==Description==
The DH-23 [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], known also by the nickname, "Outback blaster pistol," was a small [[Blaster/Legends|energy weapon]] designed mainly for durability. A modified version of the popular [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]], the DH-23 had an improved [[heat radiator shroud]] and a tighter body construction making it far harder to damage or break, although at the cost of reduced range,<ref name="AAEG" /> and strength.<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Weighing one [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]], the weapon had a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting, although it was less effective than that of the DH-17.<ref name="AAEG" /> The DH-23's maximum firing range was 80 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="AEGrange" /> and the pistol could fire 100 shots per [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]].<ref name="CWCG errata" /> Despite the decrease in power and range compared to the [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17]], the DH-23 was comparable in power to the [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18]], [[Model 44 blaster pistol|Model 44]], and numerous other blaster pistols.<ref name="AEGPOWER">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' lists this weapon's power as 3d6, the same as numerous other listed blasters in the same class.</ref>

==History==
The DH-23 was produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]],<ref name="AAEG" /> in the hope of capitalizing on the huge success of the DH-17; however, the more durable weapon never reached the levels of popularity seen by the original.<ref name="FF106">{{FactFile|106|BLA 23-24|Blastech DH-17 Blaster Pistol}}</ref> The DH-23 was sold for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="AAEG" /> and was available during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="AAEG" /> The weapons ownership and use was regulated by local authorities.<ref name="CWCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hasbro_DH-23.png|thumb|left|The Hasbro toy pistol resembling the DH-23|150px]]
The DH-23 blaster pistol was first described by authors [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] in the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2002]] for their ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AAEG" /> Several [[Hasbro]] action figures have included a silver pistol identical in appearance to the DH-23, including [[Rum Sleg/Legends|Rum Sleg]] in [[2009]]<ref name="Rum Sleg Figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|pack=#09: Rum Sleg|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBD09RumSleg.asp}}</ref> and [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] in [[2012]].<ref name="Ben Quadinaros Figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#081: Ben Quadinaros and Otoga-222|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVC81Ben.asp}}</ref> The pistols were not specifically identified on the figures' packaging and neither character has been shown to use a DH-23 in any other source.
